specs.title: primary navigation exposes exactly the four V2 destinations
moving between destinations updates the URL and the visible surface
legacy ?tab=library deep link lands on the Rides destination
legacy ?tab=profile deep link lands on the Settings destination
legacy ?tab=record deep link lands on Plan without starting a recording
the idle composer keeps trip shape and free-form planning discoverable
Draw opens the typed sketch toolbar from the V2 composer
Quick Layers keeps primary map choices bounded while Advanced preserves the map studio
a free-form ride request reaches a routed outcome
destination planning sends the selected points and displays the final route
loop planning uses one fixed start and completes with a non-empty geometry
location denial falls back to an honest approximate start and still reaches a route
provider failure ends loading and exposes a typed actionable error
a newer plan wins and a stale provider response cannot overwrite it
route alternatives arrive after the primary and selection updates the visible route
a saved route survives a reload and remains available in the library
valid GPX import appears in the route library
Free Ride accepts one suggestion into a normal guided Ride
desktop and iPhone-sized planner layouts keep controls and route outcome inside the viewport
